panels.title: Application error rate (%) by app / cluster

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time, CONCAT(resource.labels.namespace_name, ' / ', resource.labels.cluster_name) AS series, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(severity IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL','ALERT','EMERGENCY')), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS error_rate_pct FROM `${project}.platform_logs.stdout` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND resource.labels.namespace_name IN ('app1','app2') AND jsonPayload.httprequest.status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT jsonPayload.involvedobject.namespace AS namespace, COUNT(*) AS restarts FROM `${project}.platform_logs.events` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND jsonPayload.reason IN ('BackOff','OOMKilling','Unhealthy','Killing') AND jsonPayload.involvedobject.kind = 'Pod' GROUP BY namespace ORDER BY restarts DESC

panels.title: Request latency p50 / p95 / p99 (global LB, ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time, APPROX_QUANTILES(httpRequest.latency * 1000, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50, APPROX_QUANTILES(httpRequest.latency * 1000, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95, APPROX_QUANTILES(httpRequest.latency * 1000, 100)[OFFSET(99)] AS p99 FROM `${project}.platform_logs.requests` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Resource utilisation - CPU cores by app / cluster

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(start_time, HOUR) AS time, CONCAT(namespace, ' / ', cluster_name) AS series, SUM(usage.amount / TIMESTAMP_DIFF(end_time, start_time, SECOND)) AS cpu_cores FROM `${project}.gke_usage.gke_cluster_resource_consumption` WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND namespace IN ('app1','app2') AND resource_name = 'cpu' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Resource utilisation - memory GiB by app / cluster

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(start_time, HOUR) AS time, CONCAT(namespace, ' / ', cluster_name) AS series, SUM(usage.amount / TIMESTAMP_DIFF(end_time, start_time, SECOND)) / POW(1024, 3) AS memory_gib FROM `${project}.gke_usage.gke_cluster_resource_consumption` WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND namespace IN ('app1','app2') AND resource_name = 'memory' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
SELECT IFNULL(jsonPayload.enforcedsecuritypolicy.outcome, 'NONE') AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM `${project}.platform_logs.requests` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY outcome

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time, resource.labels.cluster_name AS series, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM `${project}.platform_logs.stdout` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND jsonPayload.httprequest.status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
